description: Assets for an installed native realm producer. The manifest is an artifact of the signed Coax Native update, never a free-standing trust root.

fields.runtime: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 of installed producer and shader inputs

files.path: relative cache path, shared package path grammar

rules: Exact object keys; no duplicate paths
Every file is downloaded from the fixed public object origin by its hash
Whole size and SHA-256 precede atomic cache publication
Required failure refuses opening; cancellation cannot publish a partial file
A runtime mismatch requires a native app update
